integrity: Reproducible analytical proof with a standalone symbolic and high-precision consistency checker; numerical tests are not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: No finite-time charging or discharge optimization
Fixed affinity under gap variation is a coarse-grained design constraint, not guaranteed for every mechanical implementation
No cost for maintaining or altering microscopic active reservoir or energy level
Novelty is provisional pending independent literature assessment
scientific_scope: Stationary two-state battery with fixed inverse temperature and fixed positive active affinity, variable positive excited-state gap; two objectives are relative-entropy capacity and excess internal energy.
title: A sharp inversion crossover between energy- and work-optimal active batteries
